title: 第4927章 万劫境叶炎真的突破了第4926章 一拳破一切
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：武道丹帝第一卷：默认第4927章万劫境！叶炎真的突破了（..la）“噗！”
在叶炎拳头落下之时，云飞菲的身躯宛如被一座古山狠狠的撞击了一下，鲜血随之喷涌而出，整个肉身也爆裂开来。
就算是魂魄，也是快速的爆裂开来。
“这？”
“如今……”
此刻，十大界域，万族修炼者凝神，眼眸内浮现出深深的惊愕之色。
妖千渊等天骄更是身躯颤抖，红的白的拉了一裤兜。
“云飞菲小姐，再度被轰破自身？”
“她……她不会湮灭的，她定然还有手段。”
“没错，她不会就这般死去，她可身怀不死仙体。”在这一刻，众人咬牙，开口道。
嘭！
就在他们话语至此之时，在那古战场内，一道道轰鸣声再度响起。
在所有人目光之下，云飞菲的肉身与魂魄，彻底的破灭，鲜血洒落，顿时间被祖火萦绕，焚烧为了虚无。
呼呼！
此时，这火焰更是萦绕整个古战场内，每一个角落都覆盖，如此之下，其气息仿佛瞬间被磨灭。
“这？”
看着这等一幕，很多人惊愕。
“难道……”
咕咚！
此时，妖千渊等人的身躯震颤，面色愈发的骇然。

“不……”
“那古战场，还没开启，仍在封锁之中。”但，他们目光凝聚，看向那古战场，如今这古战场之地，仍在封锁，那便代表着云飞菲还没死。
“还有戏！”
妖千渊等人深吸一口气。
嗡！
就在这一瞬，古战场内，一道光泽闪烁，随后一道身影缓缓出现。
“呼！”
看着这一道身影，妖千渊等人吐出一口浊气，“果然，云飞菲小姐岂是这般容易被诛杀？”
“她还活着，她定然是故意的，逗叶炎玩呢，她绝对还有手段，她……”
“我觉得你们还不如想点实际的，比如交待一下遗言。”而就在妖千渊等人话语至此之时，狮皇凝神，直接打断了他们。
啊？
这？
当听到狮皇的话语，妖千渊等人脸色愈发的苍白。
哗！
不过，在此时，众人的眼眸也全都凝聚，看向了那古战场云飞菲的身影之上。
咚！
就在这一刻，云飞菲竟是身影一动，向着那帝宫所在的方向：“师尊……”
“救我！”
“师兄……快出手，轰破这屏障，让我离开！”
什么？

啊？
这这这？
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Martial Arts Alchemy Emperor Volume 1: Default Chapter 4927 The Realm of Ten Thousand Tribulations! Ye Yan really broke through (..la) "Poof!"
When Ye Yan's fist fell, Yun Feifei's body felt as if it had been hit hard by an ancient mountain, blood spurted out, and the entire body exploded.
Even the soul exploded quickly.
"This?"
"Now..."
At this moment, cultivators from all races in the ten major realms were concentrating, with deep astonishment appearing in their eyes.
Yao Qianyuan and other geniuses were even more trembling, and their trouser pockets were red and white.
"Miss Yun Feifei, was she bombed again?"
"She...she won't be annihilated. She must still have means."
"That's right, she won't die like this, she has an immortal immortal body." At this moment, everyone gritted their teeth and said.
Bang!
Just as they were speaking, a series of roars sounded again in the ancient battlefield.
Under everyone's gaze, Yun Feifei's body and soul were completely shattered, blood spilled, and she was immediately surrounded by ancestral fire and burned into nothingness.
Whoops!
At this time, the flame was lingering in the entire ancient battlefield, covering every corner. Under this condition, its aura seemed to be wiped out instantly.
"This?"
Seeing this scene, many people were shocked.
"Could it be..."
Gudong!
At this time, the bodies of Yao Qianyuan and others were trembling, and their expressions became increasingly horrified.
"No..."
"The ancient battlefield has not been opened yet and is still blocked." However, their eyes focused on the ancient battlefield. Now that the ancient battlefield is still blocked, it means that Yun Feifei is not dead yet.
"There's still drama!"
Yao Qianyuan and others took a deep breath.
Buzz!
At this moment, in the ancient battlefield, a ray of light flickered, and then a figure slowly appeared.
"Phew!"
Looking at this figure, Yao Qianyuan and the others exhaled, "Sure enough, is Miss Yun Feifei so easy to be killed?"
"She is still alive. She must be teasing Ye Yan on purpose. She definitely has some tricks up her sleeve. She..."
"I think you might as well think of something practical, such as explaining your last words." Just when Yao Qianyuan and others were talking, the Lion King concentrated on them and interrupted them directly.
ah?
this?
When they heard the Lion King's words, Yao Qianyuan and others turned pale.
Wow!
However, at this moment, everyone's eyes were focused on Yun Feifei's figure on the ancient battlefield.
Boom!
At this moment, Yun Feifei actually moved and turned towards the direction of the imperial palace: "Master..."
"Help me!"
"Senior brother... take action quickly, break this barrier and let me leave!"
What?
ah?
This, this, this?
